ic_name: ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) — ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C)

voltage_levels.VDD_at_SWD_pins: Per-device VDD-IO; not specified by ADIv5.
voltage_levels.signaling: Digital CMOS / TTL — per-device datasheet. Typical 1.8 V / 2.5 V / 3.3 V.

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.swd_power_on_default_state: Idle (waiting for first Request after a line reset).
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.swd_unconditional_reset_rule: 50 consecutive SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH → line reset; SW-DP returns to Idle, SELECT and CTRL/STAT cleared, posted-read queue drained.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.swdio_sample_edge: SWCLK rising edge during Request and Data-Write phases.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.swdio_drive_edge: SWCLK falling edge during ACK and Data-Read phases (so the host can sample on the next rising edge cleanly).
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.data_parity_rule: Even parity over the 32 data bits (single parity bit transmitted after data).
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.dpidr_lsb_one_rule: DPIDR bit 0 = 1 (RAO) so that a stuck-at-zero bus is distinguishable from a real DPIDR readout.

csw_addrinc_codes.01: Single (TAR += transfer size after each DRW transfer)

default_signal_values_when_idle.SWCLK: Host-driven; idle level not specified; most probes leave SWCLK LOW between transactions.
default_signal_values_when_idle.SWDIO: Idle level HIGH — line-reset compatible. Host typically drives SWDIO HIGH between transactions; target releases SWDIO at the trailing Turnaround period.
default_signal_values_when_idle.SWO: Trace pin; idle level depends on the TPIU configuration.
